source_title: MEDKids Large Intestine starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
educational_content: The large intestine is also called the colon. Food the body cannot use moves into the large intestine. The large intestine takes in water from the leftover food. Saving water helps keep the body from drying out. What is left becomes solid waste that leaves the body.
learning_objectives: The large intestine is also called the colon.
The large intestine takes in water from leftover food.

forbidden_claims.claim: The large intestine digests most of our food
